setup_sql: CREATE TABLE bench_multimeasure_sales (region text COLLATE "C", sales_day date, is_return bool, amount int4, units int2, discount int4)

INSERT INTO bench_multimeasure_sales SELECT CASE WHEN i % 97 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 'region-' || i % 16 END, CASE WHEN i % 97 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE date '2026-01-01' + (i / 16) % 7 END, CASE WHEN i % 97 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (i / 112) % 2 = 0 END, CASE WHEN i % 97 = 0 OR i % 11 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE i % 10001 - 5000 END, CASE WHEN i % 13 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (i % 101 - 50)::int2 END, CASE WHEN i % 97 = 0 OR i % 17 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE i % 503 - 251 END FROM generate_series(1, 250000) AS g(i)
